title: 皐月賞の後に・はしりてー

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan wasn't able to take first place. However, a new spark is kindled in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she's experienced the allure of racing on a big stage, it's captured her heart. However, her toenails are in terrible shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jordan expresses her desire to keep running. We consult a doctor and begin working hard to help her nails recover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Back at school, she's greeted by an article praising her perseverance despite the odds and a group of students inspired by said article.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though embarrassed to be held up as an inspiration, she's looking forward to healing up by fall for the G2 Copa Republica Argentina.
